advertised command executed natively updates shared subject

all eleven host/style source hashes unchanged
recording: in-memory native command harness; no browser or model trial

observations.command_prefix: Mutation gestures need on edit do do rewrite: the first do belongs to lens syntax; the second to Desk command syntax. Read needs only on click do read.
observations.invalid_lens: line 1: a lens cannot say 'raw-css display:grid'. It can say: column, row, free, role, text, clamp, of <selection>, over $field, each <part>, at item, on <gesture> do <command>
observations.unknown_role: scene accepts nonexistent-role; no such role exists in calm.style. This test does not claim browser appearance.
